catalyst_tone.disclaimer: Context only — not a signal. This is a machine DIGEST of a public document, produced by an AI model after the fact. The tone / guidance / risk / reversibility readings are background context; they are NOT inputs to any score, signal or allocation unless a downstream, separately-gated step promotes a single field, and even then only as one bounded factor. “unknown” means the evidence was insufficient — the honest answer. Every non-unknown field is backed by a quote verified to appear verbatim in the source; unverifiable claims are dropped.

dislocation.headline: No acute dislocation — markets are not in a stress washout.

gate2.label: Entry timer arms only inside a buyable washout.
gate2.measured: Matched buyable washouts (2006+): waiting for the term un-inversion lifted hit 61→67%, median 63d return +2.2→+4.6%, median drawdown −4.5→−2.9%; the 1-in-10 tail was marginally worse. A confirm, not a bottom-caller.

evidence.robust: Put-present washouts had ~4pp shallower MEDIAN 3-month drawdown than put-absent — the one effect whose 95% CI excludes zero ([+0.3, +6.3], episode block bootstrap, SPY 1997-2026).
evidence.sign_consistent: Higher hit-rate and a shallower 1-year tail point the same way but their CIs span zero at ~10 effective crises — carried by leave-one-year-out (26/28 years) and BOTH split-halves, not significance.
evidence.caveat: A drawdown / risk filter, not a return signal. In a Fed-put regime even knife-looking dips often recover; in a put-absent regime (recession or inflation-locked) the same capitulation signals caught the 2000/2008/2022 falling knife.

cross_asset.headline: CONCENTRATED — 3 of 6 markets are one bet (US, Commodities, Dollar). Cross-asset correlation is in the top 2% of its 5y range: stacking these views is doubling one liquidity/risk exposure, not diversifying.
cross_asset.evidence: Absorption ratio = PC1 variance share (Kritzman-Page 2010): high/rising absorption marks a fragile one-factor regime that has historically led drawdowns. Daily closes across US/Asia/24-7 crypto carry a timezone lead/lag — a coarse regime gauge, not a hedge ratio.

fed_path.read_en: At end-2026 the market implies 3.76% vs the Fed's 3.40% median dot (+36bp — market more hawkish than the Fed). The near-term forward spread is positive — no cuts priced near-term (+0.67pp).
fed_path.read_zh: 在end-2026，市场隐含 3.76% 对比美联储 3.40% 的中位点（+36基点 — 市场比美联储更鹰派）。近端远期利差为正——近端未为降息定价（+0.67个百分点）。
fed_path.note_en: Display / LLM-context only. The implied path is a market PRICE (the futures-implied funds rate), not a forecast edge, and repricing is REACTIVE — it moves after data and the Fed, it does not lead. Never scored, never an MRS leg. ZQ/SR3 = keyless CME futures; dots = FRED FEDTARMD (FOMC SEP median). Cite the CME/FRED.
fed_path.note_zh: 仅供展示 / LLM 上下文。隐含路径是市场价格（期货隐含的基金利率），并非预测优势，且重新定价是被动的——它在数据和美联储之后变动，并不领先。从不评分，从不作为 MRS 项。ZQ/SR3=无需密钥的 CME 期货；点阵图=FRED FEDTARMD（FOMC SEP 中位数）。请注明 CME/FRED。

playbook.honesty: Sector picks vs the index showed no stable edge in our 2000-2026 backtest (results flip between decades) — so sector calls here are risk filters and confirmation tools, not return predictions. The exposure dial conditions are the statistically robust part.
playbook.honesty_zh: 在我们 2000-2026 年的回测中，相对指数的板块选择并无稳定优势 （结果在不同年代间反复翻转）— 因此这里的板块判断是风险过滤与确认工具，而非回报预测。仓位刻度盘的条件才是统计上稳健的部分。
